claim: cloud-audit 31118 front startup: start-cyberstrike-mcp-http.ps1 is meant to bring up the Heavy band on demand, versus the front being orphaned-off (nothing wired to start it).
verdict_scope: CONFIRMED for the first arm: the launcher is designed AND OS-wired to bring up the Heavy band (cloud-audit:31118). 'Orphaned-off' is REFUTED. The front is down right now due to a runtime decision (manual -Profile Full -Force restart after cloud-audit health failures), not missing wiring.
settling_probe: Third mechanism, distinct from lane A04 (static config/source reads of agents.json/.claude.json/.mcp.json/lib) and verifier V1 (Get-NetTCPConnection listener probe): (1) control-flow analysis of the launcher param block + lib profile-rank selection; (2) OS orchestration-wiring enumeration via Get-ScheduledTask actions/triggers + Get-ScheduledTaskInfo, with known-present controls (MCPAgentMailSupervisor=True, 'McpHub Autostart'=True both found, validating the detector before any absence claim); (3) live process command-line genealogy via Win32_Process; (4) supervisor.log disk-history forensics (SUPERVISOR/START/FAIL/CIRCUIT lines).
evidence: Launcher source D:/opt/cyberstrike-mcp/start-cyberstrike-mcp-http.ps1:26-27 — [ValidateSet('Core','Full','Heavy')] param, default Core; doc comment lines 10-12: 'Heavy = + cloud-audit (large Bun RSS)'. Get-CsMcpSelectedFronts (cyberstrike-mcp-lib.ps1:104-131) selects fronts by profile rank (lib:95-102 Core=1/Full=2/Heavy=3); catalog lib:73 'Name=cloud-audit; Port=31118; Band=Heavy' is the ONLY Heavy-band entry, so -Profile Heavy exists specifically to bring cloud-audit:31118 up.

OS wiring (decisive): Scheduled task 'CyberStrikeMcpHttpCore' (despite its name) action = runhidden.exe powershell ... start-cyberstrike-mcp-http.ps1 -Profile Heavy, trigger = MSFT_TaskLogonTrigger. Watchdog task 'CyberStrikeMcpWatchdog' (time trigger, last run 2026-09-19 07:16:47) runs watchdog-mcp-estate.ps1 which on supervisor death logs 'ACTION supervisor-down -> start CyberStrikeMcpHttpCore' (watchdog-mcp-estate.ps1:37, header line 3 'spawns/heals all 12 loopback fronts 31100-31119' — cloud-audit included). So autostart AND self-heal both target -Profile Heavy. Not orphaned.

Task-run to log correlation: CyberStrikeMcpHttpCore LastRun=2026-09-18 22:41:51 (LastResult=4294967295 = still-running long-lived supervisor); supervisor.log line 10989: '22:41:56 SUPERVISOR pid=13568 profile=Heavy fronts=...,cloud-audit,...' then 10998 '22:42:52 START cloud-audit :31118 pid=50252' then 11012 '22:44:39 FAIL cloud-audit :31118 health-timeout owned=1; reap'. The Heavy front WAS started by the task and died on its own health check.

Why 31118 is down now (runtime, not design): live supervisor Win32_Process pid 61728 (created 2026-09-18 22:56:25, parent 66612) runs 'start-cyberstrike-mcp-http.ps1 -Profile Full -Force' — a manual restart excluding Heavy after cloud-audit's failures (earlier circuit-open 22:23-22:31, log lines 10914-10939; health-timeout reap 22:44:39). The launcher's singleton mutex (start-cyberstrike-mcp-http.ps1:156-171) makes the watchdog see the supervisor alive, so it will NOT re-launch Heavy while 61728 lives.

Historical corroboration in supervisor.log: 27 'profile=Heavy' SUPERVISOR entries since 2026-09-06 (first at line 76, 2026-09-06T01:28:25, fronts incl. cloud-audit); cloud-audit served fine on the OLD port band then ('01:28:29 START cloud-audit :31418', '01:29:01 HAVE cloud-audit :31418') — independently re-confirming A04's port-band migration story.

Answers V1's open gap (waveD/V1.json gaps[3]): startup is SCHEDULE/TRIGGER-based (logon task + 5-min watchdog timer), NOT Claude-session-demand — no session hook references the launcher; the only doc surface is operator-facing config.md:129-133 ('singleton supervisor, profiles Core/Full/Heavy'; also warns the supervisor is a legitimately long-running parentless powershell). No on-demand-by-session mechanism exists; on-demand exists only as the operator/agent manually running the launcher with -Profile Heavy (or -Include/-Only cloud-audit).

Caveat (honest scope): the band reclassification that removed cloud-audit from profile Full happened between 22:44 and 22:50 on 2026-09-18 (22:31:21 profile=Full fronts still included cloud-audit; 22:50:09 profile=Full excludes it; lib mtime 22:48).
